title: Escaping the Self-Repair Trap: Improving Test Oracle Generation via Dual-Context Awareness
datasets: TECO-derived regression-oracle completion subset: 500 test-method prefixes from 38 Java projects; mutation-valid subset N=362. Not Defects4J/BugsInPy issue reproduction.
task: Complete/strengthen a missing assertion (regression test oracle) for a supplied test prefix; current program is assumed to represent expected behavior. Evaluate execution Pass Rate and mutation-based Kill Golden.
input_setting: Java test prefix + current focal class and callees folded into static context; LLM selects targeted runtime state queries, JDB extracts these values, then one-shot oracle generation with anti-overfitting constraints. No generated test inputs or historical buggy/fixed code pair.
author_relationship_evidence: Paper Data-Availability statement references Li et al. 2026 artifact; Zenodo record title exactly matches paper and contains DCAware source, prompts, datasets, result caches and supplementary files. Paper also links CNTG and CGNTG. CNTG README identifies invariant generation for C/C++ and requires PromptFuzz seeds; CGNTG README identifies the PromptFuzz fuzz-driver generator. The Zenodo artifact has the complete DCAware source/result bundle.
source_commit_or_archive: Zenodo 21357436, concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19238006; source archive MD5 declared 2fbe9471653b1e5093e317ab3db3c619.
license: MIT license inside DCAware source archive; Zenodo data/archive CC BY 4.0.
exact_models: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-FP8 via local vLLM, one NVIDIA A100 40GB (paper/artifact setup).
Main DCAware source default temperature 0.2; artifact README documents model endpoint settings.
weights_status: Qwen3-Coder open checkpoint, not bundled; local model serving required. GPT-5-mini is hosted Azure API. No fine-tuning reported.
evaluation_route: Official Zenodo artifact is a 1.26GB ZIP (1.69GB uncompressed); HTTP-range inspection of central directory confirms 18,134 files, source, data, prompts, result caches, JavaServer, Docker runner and MIT license. README has no-LLM smoke-check instructions, full-run scripts, and print-result scripts. Cached main outputs include 500 DCAware results per each of GPT-5-mini and Qwen3-Coder, 494 ChatAssert each. Mutation testing uses PIT. Archive was not fully downloaded/extracted; source code not executed.
blockers: This is regression-oracle completion with supplied test prefix/current version treated as expected behavior, not issue-to-reproduction test generation from buggy/fixed versions; not a Defects4J/BugsInPy study.

Full run requires Java 8 and 21, Maven, Docker, mutation testing, an A100 40GB to serve Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-FP8, or hosted Azure GPT-5-mini. Cached outputs permit score inspection without inference.
Zenodo archive is large (1.26GB compressed / 1.69GB expanded). The archive central directory and documentation were inspected via HTTP ranges; it was not fully downloaded or locally executed.
Paper uses only 500 test prefixes and mutation-valid N=362; mutation results are scoped to mutants relevant to golden oracle execution. Treat oracle metrics as benchmark-specific.
Paper describes a self-repair trap in execution-guided oracle generation; this is a regression-oracle hypothesis and does not directly validate failing-test generation from bug reports.
concept_fit: Very high for assertion/oracle quality and the risk that execution-success feedback weakens fault revelation. Static context is structural, dynamic state is LLM-selected; this supports a concept-aware oracle validation lens. Setting assumes current implementation is correct and test prefix exists.
recommendation: Strong related work for an oracle-generation thesis and a highly reproducible artifact: source, data, prompts, cached outcomes, smoke and scoring scripts are available under MIT/CC BY. Use it to justify fault-revealing metrics and distinguish successful execution from a strong oracle. It cannot serve as a direct SWT-Bench/Defects4J bug-reproduction baseline. Cached results are available; a full model rerun is conditional on A100/API and Java/Docker/PIT setup.
supporting_locations: Paper §§1–7 and Tables 1–11; full-text cache SHA-256 ddc08dc27c1c4a1d36ac4b958e978b92149c9a3a13c28ca2dc537631ffdf2659
Verified manifest paths include DCAware/context_aware.py, extract_static_context.py, evaluate_run.py, evaluate_pitest.py, README.md, REQUIREMENTS.md, STATUS.md and LICENSE.
Archive cached results: 500 context_aware outputs per primary model, 494 ChatAssert outputs per model.

GitHub CNTG is the invariant-generation component; CGNTG is PromptFuzz seed/API-sequence generation. Latest complete DCAware bundle is Zenodo record 21357436, with Zenodo-declared archive MD5 and root MIT license.
